overview: Euclid DR1 yielded a 15,072-candidate strong-lens catalogue from a pipeline fusing five ML scores with citizen-science and expert grading; companion papers cover CNN/vision-transformer segmentation and ablations. Simulation-based inference with normalizing flows, flow matching and diffusion is applied to DESI N(z), DES Y3 cosmic shear, LISA binaries and gravitational-wave tests of general relativity. Released benchmarks and tools include COSMIO, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing challenge, Survey of Surveys DR3, differentiable JAX/PyTorch galpy and SWXAI.
